findings.text: follow-on: restart_count is covered by no test, since the gate's fake manager returns ints and never reaches the systemctl show --property NRestarts read or the nonzero-returncode -> None branch at reckon/service.py:363-364, so a regression in the parse reddens no assertion.

follow-on: _crew_result_ok does not treat a cycling verdict as a refusal, so reckon crew watch --ensure still exits 0 with ok:true on a cycling unit; the human-facing detail reports it (reckon/crew/watch_unit.py:561), but a caller keying on the exit status alone still reads success.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base d020eb6a5; the single commit 1c1c54b32 adds SystemdUserUnitManager.restart_count (reckon/service.py:347), the sampler and the cycling branch to ensure_watcher_service (reckon/crew/watch_unit.py:381-586), the 170-line test module and the 27-line evidence fragment; no path outside the declaration is touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_ensure_reports_a_cycling_unit.py with a rising count reported as cycling with both counts, a held count reported as before, and a negative control; the manifest records head 60 passed/1 error EXIT=1 (logs/head-cycling-unit.log), base 57 passed/1 error EXIT=1 with the same id (logs/base-cycling-unit.log) and the negative control 1 failed/2 passed EXIT=1 (logs/negative-control-cycling-unit.log), so the gate asserts the measure.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to report a producer unit whose restart count rises between two readings as cycling from crew watch --ensure; reckon/crew/watch_unit.py:550-566 samples an already-active unchanged unit through the manager seam and sets detail to "<unit> is cycling: its restart count rose from X to Y over 10s" with cycling/restart_count_before/restart_count_after fields, reached in production by reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:2930.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, both gate arms with their failure ids and log paths, the negative control's declared string and applied mutation, and follow_ons naming the pre-existing reaper teardown error as out of scope; its changed_paths match the diff.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares five paths (reckon/crew/watch_unit.py, reckon/service.py, tests/test_ensure_reports_a_cycling_unit.py, the evidence fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/ and its figures directory); git diff --stat d020eb6a5..1c1c54b32 lists only reckon/crew/watch_unit.py, reckon/service.py, the new test module and the fragment, all inside the declaration, with the figures directory correctly untouched.

justifications.durability: tests/test_ensure_reports_a_cycling_unit.py:105-119 reddens when the two-reading sample is reverted (logs/negative-control-cycling-unit.log), but SystemdUserUnitManager.restart_count at reckon/service.py:347 is exercised by no test — the fake manager returns ints directly, so the NRestarts read is unguarded.
justifications.evidence: the manifest's after_suite at 1c1c54b32 (EXIT=1, logs/head-cycling-unit.log) fails only the reaper teardown error its baseline_suite at d020eb6a5 fails, and the negative control reddens test_a_rising_restart_count_is_reported_as_cycling (logs/negative-control-cycling-unit.log), which is the done_when's measure.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/watch_unit.py:389-405 mirrors the existing hasattr-gated manager idiom for lingering and adds no plan or ticket token to any name or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/watch_unit.py:559-566 sets detail to the cycling sentence with both readings and :585-586 return the cycling flag and the two counts, which is the report the goal names.
justifications.reuse: reckon/service.py:347 adds restart_count beside active() on the manager, extending the owner of unit-state reads, and no existing sampler or NRestarts reader was found to duplicate.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat d020eb6a5..1c1c54b32 changes only reckon/crew/watch_unit.py, reckon/service.py, tests/test_ensure_reports_a_cycling_unit.py and docs/evidence/fragments/a-seat-held-elsewhere-is-not-restarted/ensure-reports-a-cycling-unit.html, every one inside the declared write paths.
